caption: The drawing features two main objects, both depicting the same piece of furniture but shown in different views and styles. The upper part of the composition is a colored drawing of a wooden slant-front desk or bureau. It is brown with visible wood grain texture, and it has four drawers, each fitted with ornate metal handles, three handles per drawer. The bureau stands on four cabriole legs with claw-and-ball feet. The front of the slant top also has a decorative metal plate. Below this, in graphite pencil, is a monochrome sketch of the bureau’s interior with the slant top opened. This view reveals a series of small drawers and arched cubbyholes lining the back interior, with some decorative moldings visible. Both the colored and monochrome elements are centered on a plain, light beige background.
title: American Desk
